description.value:
From Green, Green Grass of Home · Price: only inside a zone you marked beforehand.

Theme Space

  • 1: 1 minute: mark a 20-ft zone. Inside it, you and your stand move double your Speed. In combat, you can instead mark a 10-ft zone around your stand with 1 action; it lasts 1 minute. Once per turn, 1 action: your stand folds the distance to a creature in a zone, Striding up to its Speed and making a Strike; the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{off-guard} against that Strike.
  • 5: Enemies inside the zone treat it as difficult terrain. Surge: fold the zone shut on a creature in it: @Damage[(2*ceil(@actor.level/2))d6[bludgeoning]] damage (@Check[fortitude|against:stand|basic]{basic Fortitude}).
  • 9: Surge: shrink a creature's distance to you: a creature inside the zone is pulled adjacent to your stand (@Check[fortitude|against:stand]{Fortitude} negates).
  • 13: Zone becomes 40 ft.
  • 17: Enemies inside the zone treat it as greater difficult terrain.

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC. A minion an ability makes, unless it says otherwise, is a creature of your level – 2 built with GM Core's Low numbers (Building Creatures), with the minion trait.
